title: OK Go · A Stone Only Rolls Downhill
description: A single yellow-case phone on a concrete slab multiplies into two, four, twelve chevron-striped phones, a spinning phone-inside-phone Droste tunnel, a 35-phone cable-wired wall with arm starbursts and tartan plaid, and an 8x8 64-phone mosaic reveal. Original instrumental with two physical CHIMERA voices.
